responsibility: Declares the small Cygwin-only option additions for the x86 target family. In practice this file contributes the driver-level -pthread switch entry used by the Cygwin configuration so the generic option machinery recognizes the spelling and passes it into the target-specific specs logic.
same_name_distinction: Unlike cygwin.h, this file only contributes the Cygwin-specific option entry for -pthread to the driver/option machinery; it does not define the Cygwin target macros, specs, or runtime linkage rules.
